ReadOnlyApi.title: Complete read-only API
ReadOnlyApi.description: Read chats, messages, CRM, automations, and operational data from every plugin through a secure contract designed for AI assistants.
ReadOnlyApi.gate_description: This section contains sensitive tokens and technical documentation. Enter the authorized access code for this device.
ReadOnlyApi.not_configured: The access code has not been configured on the server yet.
ReadOnlyApi.forbidden: Your account does not have access to this module.
ReadOnlyApi.coverage_description: Core data, CRM, conversations, automations, and plugins.
ReadOnlyApi.isolation_description: Each token can only read data from the team that created it.
ReadOnlyApi.openapi_description: A discoverable contract for clients, scripts, and AI tools.
ReadOnlyApi.ai_description: Downloadable MCP server and ready-to-use technical context.
ReadOnlyApi.parameters_description: Available pagination, search, and exact filters.
ReadOnlyApi.fields_description: Internal secrets are removed before the response is serialized.
ReadOnlyApi.guide_auth_description: Send the token in Authorization: Bearer. Never put it in the URL, source code, or execution logs.
ReadOnlyApi.guide_pagination_description: Use per_page=100 and continue with meta.nextPage while meta.hasMore is true. An empty page does not replace checking meta.
ReadOnlyApi.guide_relations_description: The API does not fabricate joined objects: connect chatId, contactId, userId, departmentId, funnelStageId, and other identifiers across resources.
ReadOnlyApi.recipe_conversations_description: Reconstruct the complete context for every contact and conversation.
ReadOnlyApi.recipe_conversations_steps:
1. Read contacts and chats.
2. Query messages?chatId=<id> through every page.
3. Join assignedUserId, assignedDepartmentId, and funnelStageId.
4. Resolve contact-tags through tags.
5. Interpret customData using custom-fields.
ReadOnlyApi.recipe_automations_description: Compare the configured definition with the sessions that actually ran.
ReadOnlyApi.recipe_automations_steps:
1. Read automation-folders and automations.
2. Inspect nodes, edges, trigger, and active state.
3. Filter automation-sessions?automationId=<id>.
4. Join chatId and contactId with chats and contacts.
5. Compare messages where isAutomation=true.
ReadOnlyApi.recipe_crm_description: Get distribution, ownership, and commercial context without losing assignments.
ReadOnlyApi.recipe_crm_steps:
1. Read funnel-groups, funnel-stages, and funnel-group-members.
2. Traverse contacts by funnelStageId.
3. Join departments and department-members.
4. Add tags, custom fields, sales, and memberships.
5. Keep contacts without a stage as an explicit category.
ReadOnlyApi.recipe_plugins_description: Start with the live registry, then query each module's own data.
ReadOnlyApi.recipe_plugins_steps:
1. Read plugin-catalog for every registered module.
2. Compare installed-plugins and member-plugins.
3. Inspect routes, scopes, and featureFlags.
4. Query that plugin's resource family.
5. Private credentials and tokens are always omitted.
ReadOnlyApi.errors_description: Every error uses error.code and error.message; retain the HTTP status to decide whether to correct, reauthenticate, or retry.
ReadOnlyApi.errors_400: An identifier or filter has an invalid type. Correct the parameter and query again.
ReadOnlyApi.errors_401: The token is missing, expired, or revoked. Do not retry without renewing the credential.
ReadOnlyApi.errors_404: The resource or record does not exist inside the authorized team.
ReadOnlyApi.errors_429: The 120 requests per minute limit was reached. Wait until X-RateLimit-Reset.
ReadOnlyApi.token_management_description: Tokens are shown once; only their hash is stored afterward.
ReadOnlyApi.tokens_empty: There are no read-only tokens yet.
ReadOnlyApi.revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? It will stop working immediately.
ReadOnlyApi.token_revoke_error: The token could not be revoked
ReadOnlyApi.mcp_description: Download the dependency-free connector and add it to Claude Desktop or a Codex client with MCP support.
ReadOnlyApi.claude_code_description: Lets Claude Code query authorized WhatsPro data through read-only MCP tools.
ReadOnlyApi.claude_code_install_help: Download the MCP server first, replace the absolute path and token with your team values, then run this command in a terminal.
ReadOnlyApi.claude_code_verify_help: Verify the connection with “claude mcp get whatspro-readonly” or with /mcp inside Claude Code.
ReadOnlyApi.codex_config_help: Codex, its desktop app, CLI, and IDE extension share MCP configuration from ~/.codex/config.toml. Save the downloaded file at an absolute path and restart the client.
ReadOnlyApi.claude_config_help: In Claude Desktop, add the same STDIO server under mcpServers and restart the application.
ReadOnlyApi.machine_docs_description: OpenAPI plus an extensive Markdown guide an AI can read before querying data.
ReadOnlyApi.ai_prompt_description: Use it after connecting MCP or providing OpenAPI to the assistant.
ReadOnlyApi.ai_prompt: Use the WhatsPro API exclusively in read-only mode. First list resources and load the AI context. Never attempt POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE. Follow all required pages and relate chats, messages, contacts, stages, departments, tags, and custom fields before reaching conclusions. Never reveal the token or secret values.
ReadOnlyApi.read_only_guarantee_description: The router exports only GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS. Every other method receives 405.
ReadOnlyApi.secret_redaction_description: Passwords and WhatsApp, Meta, Hostinger, AI, AAPP, and private configuration tokens never appear in responses.
ReadOnlyApi.team_scope_description: Every query adds a team constraint, including tables related through a parent record.
ReadOnlyApi.hashed_tokens_description: The full secret is delivered once. The database keeps only SHA-256 and identification metadata.
ReadOnlyApi.rate_limit_description: Each token allows up to 120 requests per minute and reports its state through standard headers.
ReadOnlyApi.revocation_description: Token creation and revocation are logged, and revocation takes effect immediately.
